_about: Diego de San Pedro. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Prison of Love (Cárcel de amor). Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling. The text is the EEBO-TCP transcription of Lord Berners's Castell of Love (c.1548), keyed by hand from the page images (the scan's own OCR was black-letter garble). Spelling is the printing's; TCP marks every unread letter as a <gap>, never a guess.

pedro-castell-love.year: c.1548 (TCP record: STC 21739.5; dated 1548 in the catalogue; IA dates the same printing 1560)
pedro-castell-love.evidence: TCP catalogue A11488 read (San Pedro, Diego de; Berners, John Bourchier, Lord; 217 pp.); file's <availability> states CC0 1.0; title page in the text: 'translated out of Spanishe in to Englyshe, by Iohan Bowrchier knyght, lorde Bernis'.
pedro-castell-love.case: Bloom lists Cárcel de amor. Berners's Castell of Love is the classic and only pre-1931 English version; the TCP transcription is a clean, hand-keyed witness of it.
pedro-castell-love.note: The body spells the translator Bowrchier, so the checks use that form (Berners is also claimed by french-classics). 167 illegible gaps marked by the keyers. Replaces the IA attempt (bim_early-english-books-1475-1640_the-castell-of-love-_san-pedro-diego-de_1560), whose OCR failed the gate.
